correctness.rationale: Taking u=K^(−1/2), k=(1−u²)/(1+u²). The exact cited source formula x=(3−k²−sqrt((1−k²)(9−k²)))/2 gives x=1−2√2u+2u²+O(u³). Thus C=2x^(3/2)/(k(1+x))=1−2√2u+3u²+O(u³), and r=√x/k=1−√2u+2u²+O(u³). Both deficits positive for sufficiently small u, ratio →2. Independent symbolic series checked, as well as correct k→1− mapping. These calculations are valid if original exact sharpness and maximizer hypotheses hold; that source theorem was not independently full-text verified this run.
